# img_resize — Image Resize & Channel Texture Optimizer CLI

- purpose: Resize, audit, and optimize game textures (PNG/JPG/WebP/BMP/GIF/TIFF) with `$engine_$channel.yml` best-practice profiles. Local & offline, no network deps.
- version: 0.4.0
- language: Rust
- type: CLI binary
- supported-formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF (input); PNG, JPEG, WebP (output)

## Command Syntax

```
img_resize optimize <PROFILE_YML> [PATH] [-o <DIR>] [--dry-run] [--report <FILE>] [--jobs <N>] [--json]
img_resize profile list [--json]
img_resize profile init <PRESET> [-o <FILE>] [-f|--force] [--json]
img_resize r_resize <PATH> [-o <DIR>] [OPTIONS] [--json]
```

## Subcommand: `optimize`

- `<PROFILE_YML>`: Path to `$engine_$channel.yml` (required, positional). Engine and channel can be inferred from filename stem (e.g. `godot_wx-minip.yml`) and inherit built-in preset defaults.
- `[PATH]`: Input image or directory (optional positional; overrides `input:` in YAML)
- `-o, --out-dir <DIR>`: Output directory (overrides `output:` in YAML; omits -> in-place overwrite). Preserves relative directory structure by default.
- `--dry-run`: Analyze effective pixel ratios and simulate encoding without writing image files
- `--report <FILE>`: Write full JSON report to FILE (registered as artifact role `report`)
- `--jobs <N>`: Parallel worker threads (default: CPU cores)

### Built-in Presets (`$engine_$channel`)

- `godot_wx-minip`: Godot WASM WeChat Mini Game (max 1024px, align 4, PNG quantize 78..92 + PSNR>=38dB + oxipng L3, JPG 82, WebP 82)
- `godot_qq-minip`: Godot WASM QQ Mini Game (max 1024px, align 4, PNG quantize 78..92 + PSNR>=38dB + oxipng L3, JPG 82, WebP 82)
- `godot_dy-minip`: Godot WASM Douyin Mini Game (max 1024px, align 4, PNG quantize 75..90 + PSNR>=37dB + oxipng L3, JPG 80, WebP 80)
- `godot_zfb-minip`: Godot WASM Alipay Mini Game (max 1024px, align 4, PNG quantize 76..90 + PSNR>=37.5dB + oxipng L4, JPG 80, WebP 80)
- `godot_mobile`: Godot Native Mobile iOS/Android (max 2048px, align 4, PNG lossless + oxipng L3, JPG 88, WebP 88)
- `raw_png-jpg`: Generic PNG/JPG channel (no forced downscale, PNG quantize 80..95 + PSNR>=39dB + oxipng L4, JPG 84, WebP 84)

### Optimization Pipeline

1. Effective pixel analysis: `effective_pixel_ratio`, `bbox_area_ratio`, fake-alpha detection (`min_alpha >= opaque_threshold`), unique color count (<=256 lossless palette), grayscale detection.
2. Safe pixel cleanup: `strip_fake_alpha` (RGBA -> RGB), `zero_transparent_rgb` with `edge_bleed_px` dilation (prevents bilinear black fringes). `trim_transparent` defaults to `false` (enable selectively in `rules:`).
3. Resize + `align_multiple` (never upscales; `lanczos3` default).
4. Format routing: `opaque_png_to`, `alpha_png_to`, `jpg_to`, `webp_to` (`keep|png|jpg|webp`; defaults to `keep` to protect Godot `res://` refs).
5. Encoding: PNG (`imagequant` + `min_psnr_db` lossless fallback + `oxipng`), JPG (metadata-stripped), WebP (lossy VP8 or lossless VP8L).
6. No-regression guard (`no_regression: true`, `min_saving_pct: 1.0`): keeps original bytes if output is not smaller on unresized/unconverted files.
7. Default Godot protection rules (`inherit_default_rules: true`): normal/orm/mask/roughness/metallic/height/bump/ao maps, `**/fonts/**`, and `**/*_pixel*.*` forced lossless.

## Subcommand: `profile`

- `img_resize profile list [--json]`: list all built-in presets
- `img_resize profile init <PRESET> [-o <FILE>] [-f] [--json]`: write commented `$engine_$channel.yml` template (checked-in copies live in `img_resize/profiles/`)

## Subcommand: `r_resize`

- `<PATH>`: Image file or directory path (required, positional)
- `-o, --out-dir <DIR>`: Write results into DIR instead of overwriting inputs (not allowed with `-c`)
- `-m, --max-pixel <SIZE>`: Longest-side proportional scale (Lanczos3)
- `--rw <WIDTH>` + `--rh <HEIGHT>`: Exact resize (CatmullRom)
- `-c, --resize-config <FILE>`: Legacy YAML (`vec_size`, `vec_f`, `base_f`) multi-size PNG output
- `-j, --force-jpg`: Convert to JPG (quality 100) without resizing

## Examples

```bash
img_resize profile list --json
img_resize profile init godot_wx-minip -o godot_wx-minip.yml
img_resize optimize godot_wx-minip.yml ./assets -o ./out --dry-run --json
img_resize optimize profiles/godot_dy-minip.yml ./assets -o ./out --report report.json --json
img_resize r_resize -m 800 image.jpg -o out/
```

## Notes

- `tinyfy` subcommand is disabled and hidden (OpenSSL/musl incompatibility); use local `optimize`.
- Local PNG quantization uses `imagequant` (GPL-3.0).
- `optimize` JSON data: `{profile, dry_run, input, output_dir?, summary:{total, optimized, unchanged, skipped, failed, total_original_bytes, total_output_bytes, saved_bytes, saved_pct, fake_alpha_stripped_count, low_effective_pixel_count, quantize_fallback_count}, audit_hotspots:[...], results:[...]}`.

## Build

```bash
cd img_resize && cargo build --release
```

## Machine Call Contract (r_lit CLI contract v1)

- spec: docs/cli-contract.md (repo root); implementation: crates/rlit_cli
- json: `--json` is global; stdout carries exactly one JSON envelope, also on failure; logs go to stderr
- envelope: {"contract":1, "ok", "tool":"img_resize", "version", "command", "data", "artifacts":[{"path","role","bytes","sha256"}], "error":null|{"code","kind","message"}, "warnings"?}
- exit_codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 input, 4 external, 5 partial (ok=false, data still complete)
- schema: `img_resize __schema` prints JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) per subcommand, with x-cli (argv mapping, io role), x-effects, x-env, x-stdin, x-note
- non_interactive: never prompts
- effects: optimize=pure, r_resize=pure, profile list=read-only, profile init=pure
